title: Chapter 27: The Fangs to Stay Alive
content:
Chapter 27:

The Fangs that Struggle for Life

His throat trembled. His soul screamed.

Tearing through flesh, invading nerves, a sharp, excruciating pain that threatened to drive him mad struck his brain.

“

Gyaaaaaaahhh

—!!”

His vision turned bright red, and he couldn’t grasp reality at all.

His right thigh area was being bitten by a black beast. Before the thought to tear it off could run through his mind, the reaction of raising a scream against the agony was faster.

—

It hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts

.

His head was completely filled with that, leaving no room to even think of a counterattack.

Suddenly, his sense of balance collapsed. The biting beast shook its head with its fangs still thrust in, pulling Subaru, who easily outweighed it by nearly double, down to the ground.

“Ugh—”

Carried by the momentum, he half-rotated and was slammed face-down onto the ground. His face, failing to break the fall, crashed into the soil; the sensation of his nose being crushed and the taste of dirt in his mouth.

Pain continued to assert itself from both above and below, and while spitting out dirt, Subaru’s throat continued to raise a low groan. Then, realizing that the sensation of fangs had left his right leg, he hurriedly flipped his body over.

“This is bad…!”

Returning to his back, he raised his upper body.

Copious bleeding could be seen from his right leg, and the flesh of the skin under his torn clothes was turned up. Pain flared up again from the wound that looked like it had been gouged by a knife, but prioritizing standing up over that—he wouldn’t make it in time.

Having sealed the prey’s movement, the jet-black shadow moving to pursue was too fast to follow.

Against the wild beast approaching while bounding left and right on the ground, the only reaction Subaru could manage was to cover his upper body with both arms.

A flash of the swung sharp beast claws tore through Subaru’s right arm from the back of the hand to the shoulder in one go. Blood spurted, pain nerves applauded the manifestation of the new wound, and Subaru’s brain boiled with a heavy ensemble of intense agony.

Before biting off his throat, it intended to crush his limbs and rob him of the power to resist.

Experiencing the cruelty of a wild hunt firsthand, Subaru shuddered and screamed.

That sound, which didn’t form meaningful words, had no effect on the horned beast’s movements. As if performing a task it was used to, indifferently, the horned beast bit into the left wrist of the merely screaming Subaru, robbing him of the function of a third limb.

The sensation of fangs penetrating his left wrist.

A sensation that surpassed pain and was now nothing more than something inducing screams. Under conditions where his vision flickered and even thoughts didn’t run properly, what still drove Subaru was only his reflexive survival instinct.

“Aaaaaah—!! Damn it all!!”

Screaming, with all his might, he slammed the beast into the ground along with his bitten left wrist. Its jaw strength wasn’t so weak that the fangs would come out with just that. While soiling its black fur with blood and saliva, the horned beast pushed its fangs in deeply as if mocking Subaru’s resistance.

Into the side of its face,

“Don’t get, cocky—!!”

The quill pen he hadn’t dropped yet pierced deeply into the wild beast’s left eye.

At the sensation of its eyeball being crushed and the inside stirred, it was the horned beast’s turn to roar.

At the unexpected retaliation from the opponent it had determined to be helpless prey, the wild beast thrashed its whole body in resistance. However, Subaru judged that if he let go here, there would be no next time.

Covering the beast with his whole body, keeping not only his right arm thrusting the quill pen but also his bitten left arm as it was, he absolutely would not let that body escape.

“It hurts it hurts it hurts it hurts it hurts—”

His right leg, with its nerves damaged, couldn’t hold firm; his left arm had the wrist dangling by a single piece of skin; and on his right arm, bone was visibly deep within the turned-up wound.

There was a sensation of a nosebleed flowing endlessly from his battered nose, and he felt like he might be missing two or three front teeth if he wasn’t careful.

Even in such a state, he did his utmost to escape from the predicament before his eyes.

There was pain. There was suffering. There was fear. He was alive.

Both himself and this beast were still breathing.

“Agaah—”

The beast’s blindly swung claws grazed his forehead, and at the sensation of his brain being shaken, his hold loosened. In that opening, the horned beast shoved Subaru away and distanced itself with the quill pen still stuck in its left eye.

With a single leap, it moved several meters away, and just like that, the jet-black shadow melted into the forest and vanished.

Subaru, collapsed on the soil, searched for that vanished figure, forgetting even the pain.

He couldn’t think optimistically that it retreated due to injury.

It was a well-heard story that a wounded beast is terrifying. And for the beast, Subaru would also be a wounded opponent.

For both of them, the opponent was an existence whose life had to be ended here.

“——It hurts.”

Kneeling on his right leg which couldn’t hold firm, he raised his body relying only on his left leg. Both arms were wretched to look at; especially his left hand looked so bad he felt his heart would break just seeing it, so he couldn’t direct his gaze at it.

An illusion as if the side of his head were being beaten repeatedly. Temporarily thrusting the continuously ringing alarm of pain into his subconscious, Subaru’s gaze glared at the forest where the beast had disappeared.

It will definitely come.

That baseless conviction might have been the gift of the few experiences he had gained in this world, for Subaru who had faced murderous intent not a few times until now.

“――――!!”

Was it Subaru or the opponent who raised a scream like holding their breath?

The only thing known was the fact that before the bracing Subaru’s eyes, opening a mouth lined with sharp fangs, the horned beast flew in like a bullet.

Subaru tasted with his whole body the power of a creature weighing over thirty kilos charging at full speed without holding back. And that, with the constraint of the condition that he couldn’t receive the blessing of support from both legs.

With a split-second judgment, his right arm went up, and the horned beast’s bite ended in failure as its jaw was struck from directly below. However, he couldn’t kill even a speck of the charge’s destructive power, and Subaru’s body rolled on the ground entangled with the horned beast, carried by the momentum of the crash.

“Ooooooaaaaaaaah—”

Blown backward, while hitting his whole body hard, Subaru swung his arms frantically. On the way, feeling the sensation of touching hard fur, he grabbed it with all his might, and clung to it determining never to let go, even if he didn’t know what part it was.

Rolling on the ground while entangled, eventually Subaru and the beast’s bodies entered a slope. Far from stopping, they gained momentum aiming for the bottom of the slope, and in the end,

“——You’ve gotta be kidding.”

Suddenly, the sensation of the hard ground that had been battering his whole body vanished.

Gaining the floating sensation that attacked immediately after, Subaru realized he had thrown himself off a cliff.

“――――!!”

Was the voiceless scream again screamed by either Subaru or the beast?

As a result, that scream didn’t last very long.

The floating sensation was cut off in just about two seconds, and his bones creaked at the impact of hitting his whole body hard again. A dull sound rang out, and he thought somewhere probably actually broke. However, prioritizing the judgment that his body was in no state to worry about that.

Extending his left arm which had no sensation beyond the wrist, he tried to kill the rolling momentum as if clawing the ground. The fingernails of the five fingers spread on the rock surface were peeled off, and spots like sprayed paint were drawn on the rock wall by the spurting fresh blood.

Doing that much, the momentum finally slackened, and Subaru’s body barely stopped at the edge of another cliff. Stopping in a state where half his body was protruding into the air, Subaru hurriedly rolled his body toward where there was ground, and,

“Buhaa… haa… ah, ah, ah, shit!”

Pinching his nose, he vigorously expelled the noseblood that hadn’t finished flowing.

Unable to judge whether the liquid accumulated in his mouth was saliva, blood, or stomach acid, he spat it all out onto the ground along with curses.

Breathing roughly, grimacing all over his face at the pain of lacerations and bruises his whole body complained of, Subaru then realized that the figure of the beast that had fallen with him was not there.

“Hey, where…!?”

It wasn’t the time to think avoiding death by falling was lucky.

If he received its attack again, the fate of Subaru, similarly at the edge of a cliff, would be decided this time for sure. Assuming the figure of the horned beast jumping back nimbly and threatening him, Subaru looked around while changing his posture.

And he immediately caught that black figure in his vision.

“…Is that so, you couldn’t make it, huh.”

The figure of the horned beast existed beneath Subaru’s eyes, at the bottom of that cliff.

Unlike Subaru, it hadn’t been able to avoid a second fall. Unable to endure the fall from a height more than double the first one, the beast, which seemed to have fallen headfirst, lay on its side atop copious bloodstains, not moving a twitch.

—Apparently, Subaru had picked up his life again.

“Dammit… this is, ridiculous…”

Relief pierced into the gaps of his heart, perhaps because he had witnessed the end of that life.

Subaru, who was also bleeding in a way that couldn’t be overlooked, lay on his side on the ground and closed his eyelids, unable to resist the attacking drowsiness.

Just like that, without being able to think anything, his consciousness fell and vanished.
